name: STL_Tree_EraseIter_IntKey_N28_004d11d0
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frame_input_tick, read-only analysis. Supersedes STL_xlen_throw_004d11d0: this is not a length-error throw site but MSVC std::_Tree<...>::erase(iterator) for the 28h-node instantiation. __thiscall(this = tree, iterator* result, iterator by value {_Mycont, _Ptr}), RET 0Ch. The three arguments at the BSP_Game_OnMove call site 004e4fd2 are the hidden return-iterator pointer plus one checked iterator passed as two dwords, not three independent values. 004d11ec rejects a nil node and raises the MSVC debug message 'invalid map/set<T> iterator' (00ce44e0) through __CxxThrowException, which is what the old tag matched. It calls 004bf830 to compute the successor it returns and releases the erased node's value. The sibling 004d41a0 is the matching erase(first,last), whose whole-range fast path resets _Myhead->_Left/_Parent/_Right to _Myhead and _Mysize to 0 at 004d41f2..004d4204, fixing the container as {iterator list +0h, _Myhead +4h, _Mysize +8h}.

name: BSP_Game_EnqueueStateRequest
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = the ring buffer embedded at game+5D8h, one stack argument pointing at the 10h-byte element to copy, RET 4. Fields: +4 bucket array, +8 capacity, +0Ch head, +10h count; it grows through 004d20d0(1) when head+count is 4-aligned and the capacity is reached, allocates a 10h bucket on demand and copies the element in. BSP_Game_BeginStartupSequence uses it at 004e5796 to post state 10 after writing game+5D4h. Eleven callers, all game-state transitions including BSP_Game_OnMove. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_GAME_ENTRY.md. | Correction (docs/GAME_FRAME_CONTROL.md): the container at game+5D8h is an MSVC std::deque<int> with four elements per 16-byte block; +5E0h is the block count and +5E4h the element offset, not a capacity and a byte offset; the argument is a const int&, so call sites push a stack slot's address; the earlier 10h-byte element is the block size.

name: BSP_Game_CheckMissionCompletion

Returns at once unless game+5E8h is zero and game+7188h is non-null, so the poll waits for an empty state-request queue. name: BSP_GameInputContexts_SetLevel4Set

name: BSP_Game_RecordActionDeadlines

name: BSP_FrontEnd_ActionEdgeOrRepeat
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = the game at 00E188A8, int action), returns char. Ghidra types the argument as float, which is why its compares render as denormals; they are the integers 46h, 47h, 4Ah, 4Bh, 4Ch, 4Dh, 4Eh..55h, 57h, 58h. Scales the action by 30h into the record table *(BSP_InputManager_GetSingleton()+4) of docs/GAME_INPUT_TICK.md and reads +1Ch previous hold, +20h previous down, +24h current hold, +28h current down. Fires on a fresh press (down now with hold > 0 and not already down with hold > 0) and sets the per-action deadline in the map 004D6900 keys to game+64Ch + 0.4 (double at 00CE65D0); otherwise fires as an auto-repeat when still down, hold > 00D7A218 (0.0f) and game+64Ch is strictly greater than the deadline, which then becomes game+64Ch + 0.1 (double at 00D7A3A0). Then raises one UI sound flag on BSP_SoundRequestQueue_GetSingleton: +1Bh for action 4Bh alone, +1Ah for 4Ah and 4Eh..55h, +19h for 46h, 47h, 4Ch, 4Dh, 57h, 58h. In the main-menu update 4Ah is accept, 4Bh is back and 50h is a third action, established by matching the GUI handler 005993A0's control codes A2h, A3h and A7h arm for arm. docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREEN_UPDATE.md.

name: BSP_Game_TogglePauseMenu
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = game, no stack arguments, RET at 004db0a0, 004db0b0, 004db148 and 004db183. It opens with FLDZ and calls BSP_InputManager_GetSingleton then BSP_InputManager_Update(0.0f), so the input tick is re-run with a zero delta and no hold timer advances across the transition; the decompiler renders that zero as an integer. Single player (game+1FE4h == 0) it flips the HUD flag through 004cd0f0(game, game+634h == 0, 0, 1) and then opens or closes the pause screen with 005ff0d0 or 005fd440 on ECX = [00e198c4]+D8h, calling 004d95f0(game, paused) either way. Multiplayer it calls 004cd0f0 only when game+218Ch is set and switches on [00e198b4]+3Ch, using 00689030 to push INTF_MULTIINGAME or 006882a0 to pop it. Because 004cd0f0 receives allow_simulation = 0, hiding the HUD here also clears game+635h and closes the simulation gate on the next frame. Evidence: docs/GAME_SIMULATION_GATE.md.
